examples.text: During the Cultural Revolution I was exiled to Xincai County in Henan Province. There, 36 percent of the people starved to death in the early 1960s.

glosses: To suffer severely because of lack of food or of not eating.

glosses: To be very hungry.

examples.text: I was starving so I wrote S.O.S. on the desert island using rocks.

glosses: To kill or attempt to kill by depriving of food.
To make suffer severely by depriving of food.
To force a combatant to submit or surrender by depriving of food, as in a targeted siege.

examples.text: If they refuse to surrender the garrison, we'll just starve them out.

glosses: To force a population center to submit or surrender by depriving of food, as in sieges in international armed conflicts.

examples.text: Some historians have since classified the Siege of Leningrad as a genocide due to the intentional destruction of the city and the systematic starvation of its civilian population.

glosses: To deprive of nourishment or of some vital component.

examples.text: The uncaring parents starved the child of love.
The patient’s brain was starved of oxygen.

glosses: To squeeze a small amount of a person's skin and flesh, making it hurt.

examples.text: The children were scolded for pinching each other.
This shoe pinches my foot.

glosses: To squeeze between the thumb and forefinger.

examples.text: He took the plate in his hand, holding it between thumb and forefinger at one corner, letting it hang down. With the other hand he pinched it at the opposite corner, pressing thumb and forefinger together tightly.

glosses: To squeeze between two objects.

examples.text: Since the resistance of the channel is inversely proportional to its width, the most resistive region is the one pinched between the gates where they come closest to each other.

glosses: Of clothing, to be uncomfortably tight in specific spots.

examples.text:
With their jock-straps pinching, they slouch to attention
While queueing for sarnies at the office canteen.

glosses: To steal, usually something inconsequential.

examples.text: Someone has pinched my handkerchief!
